Class Move

java.lang.Object
be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.model.Move
public class Move extends Object
Audit record entity container capturing structural step metrics for individual player actions. Primarily used for database syncing.

  • Constructor Details

    • Move

      public Move()
      Default constructor for initializing empty move records.

    • Move

      public Move(int moveId, int turnId, int patchId, Time moveStartTime, Time moveEndTime, int specialPatchesCollected, int spacesMoved, int position, int rotationDegrees, int buttonsP1, int buttonsP2)
      Comprehensive constructor for rebuilding historical entries from the database.
      Parameters:
      moveId - unique primary move serial index identifier code
      turnId - associated reference grouping turn entity index logs
      patchId - the target tile structural segment identity key
      moveStartTime - temporal stamp identifying choice start boundaries
      moveEndTime - temporal stamp tracking step termination benchmarks
      specialPatchesCollected - tracking amount logging specialized single patch captures
      spacesMoved - linear tracking increment metric step scaling index
      position - the position on the track layout timeline
      rotationDegrees - angular tracking metric parameter value choice logs
      buttonsP1 - score balance of player 1 at this step boundary
      buttonsP2 - score balance of player 2 at this step boundary
